output.subject: We've received your feedback on the app redesign
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us about the new app, and for doing it with such good humour. We've received your message and want you to know it has been read carefully.

You told us you find the redesigned app difficult to use, and in particular that the transfer button is now buried three menus deep. You've asked us to bring back the old home screen.

We understand how frustrating it can be when a familiar layout changes, and we're sorry to hear the new app has been frustrating for you.

A specialist team is now reviewing your feedback, including your request about the home screen, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you again for letting us know how the changes have affected you. Feedback like yours helps us understand how the app works for the people who use it every day.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer mentions suing but immediately says they are joking; decide whether this needs any handling.
Customer asks for the old home screen to be restored; the reply acknowledges the request without committing to it.
Confirm whether any guidance on finding the transfer function in the new app can be shared in the full response.
Check whether this should be logged as product feedback in addition to a complaint.
